notes:
# Sign in with Zoom, first {link}
When a Zoom Events page asks who you are, RecordLah! now presses "Sign in
with Zoom" first. It uses the Zoom account your browser is already signed
in to, so no emailed code is needed. If the page still asks, it falls back
to the emailed code as before.
